I am a journalist and I worked for a print newspaper for eleven years. In my time at the paper I used to read subreddits like this (there wasn't a Voat.co yet) and I often lamented reading an interesting fact of history on the day of its anniversary, when it was already useless to me, instead of the day before, when I could have actually used it to write something in time for the next day's edition.
